questions.question: State the main difference between ANOVA and Kruskal-Wallis test.
questions.solution_html:
• ANOVA is a parametric test that assumes normal distribution of data.
  • Kruskal-Wallis test is a non-parametric test that does not assume normal distribution.
questions.final_answer: ANOVA is a parametric test that assumes normal distribution of data

questions.question: Describe null hypothesis, alternate hypothesis, significance level and p-value in respect of paired-sample t-test.
questions.solution_html:
• respect of paired-sample t-test.
  • (Null Hypothesis – (4 Marks); Alternate Hypothesis – (3 Marks); Significance
  • Level – (4 Marks); p-value – (4 Marks))
  • Null Hypothesis (H₀) – No difference
  • Alternate Hypothesis (H₁) – Difference
  • Significance Level (α) – 0.05 level
  • p-value – Probability value
  • Decision –
  • p ≤ 0.05 Reject H₀
  • p > 0.05 Accept H₀
